integrity: The self-contained integer bitmaps and standard-library checker fully exhaust the three finite cases; no external certification or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the binary closed-in-ball, indexed-vertex critical-radius cases (5,3), (7,4), (9,5) are proved. The general critical-radius problem is not solved; unindexed prior constructions could exist.
title: Sharp critical-radius identifying codes for three binary de Bruijn networks
